scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:css && npm run build:web && npm run check && npm test
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && npm --prefix functions test && playwright test
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && eslint src scripts functions/src tests && tsc --noEmit && npm --prefix functions run check && node --check public/js/app.js && node --check public/js/rpc-bridge.js && node --check public/js/pwa.js
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write src scripts tests package.json tsconfig.json playwright.config.js eslint.config.mjs
